verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־ בֹשֵׁ֥שׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָרֶ֣דֶת מִן־ הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעָ֜ם עַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ ק֣וּם׀ עֲשֵׂה־ לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵֽלְכוּ֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כִּי־ זֶ֣ה׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־ הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar hā·‘ām kî- ḇō·šêš mō·šeh lā·re·ḏeṯ min- hā·hār way·yiq·qā·hêl hā·‘ām ‘al- ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw qūm ‘ă·śêh- lā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer yê·lə·ḵū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū kî- zeh mō·šeh hā·’îš ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lō yā·ḏa‘·nū meh- hā·yāh lōw
verses.literal: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain they gathered around Aaron and said Come make us gods who will go before us As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt we do not know what has happened to him

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן פָּֽרְקוּ֙ נִזְמֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָבִ֖יאוּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’a·hă·rōn pā·rə·qū niz·mê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer bə·’ā·zə·nê nə·šê·ḵem bə·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hā·ḇî·’ū ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: So Aaron told them Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters and bring them to me

verses.original: וַיִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם אֶת־ נִזְמֵ֥י הַזָּהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pā·rə·qū kāl- hā·‘ām ’eṯ- niz·mê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer bə·’ā·zə·nê·hem way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’el- ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Then all the people took off their gold earrings - and brought them to Aaron

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מִיָּדָ֗ם וַיָּ֤צַר אֹתוֹ֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶט וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mî·yā·ḏām way·yā·ṣar ’ō·ṯōw ba·ḥe·reṭ way·ya·‘ă·śê·hū ‘ê·ḡel mas·sê·ḵāh way·yō·mə·rū ’êl·leh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lū·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: He took the gold from their hands and with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf And they said These O Israel are your gods who brought you up out of the land of Egypt

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לְפָנָ֑יו וַיִּקְרָ֤א אַֽהֲרֹן֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר חַ֥ג לַיהוָ֖ה מָחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’a·hă·rōn way·yi·ḇen miz·bê·aḥ lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yiq·rā ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mar ḥaḡ Yah·weh mā·ḥār
verses.literal: When Aaron saw this he built an altar before the calf and proclaimed . . . . . . Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֙ימוּ֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיַּעֲל֣וּ עֹלֹ֔ת וַיַּגִּ֖שׁוּ שְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב הָעָם֙ לֶֽאֱכֹ֣ל וְשָׁת֔וֹ וַיָּקֻ֖מוּ לְצַחֵֽק׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kî·mū mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·ya·‘ă·lū ‘ō·lōṯ way·yag·gi·šū šə·lā·mîm way·yê·šeḇ hā·‘ām le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·šā·ṯōw way·yā·qu·mū lə·ṣa·ḥêq
verses.literal: So the next day they arose offered burnt offerings and presented peace offerings And the people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה לֶךְ־ רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh leḵ- rêḏ kî ši·ḥêṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go down at once . . . for your people whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt have corrupted themselves

verses.original: סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־ לוֹ֙ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ ל֔וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: sā·rū ma·hêr min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯim ‘ā·śū lā·hem ‘ê·ḡel mas·sê·ḵāh way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw way·yiz·bə·ḥū- lōw way·yō·mə·rū ’êl·leh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lū·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them They have made for themselves a molten calf and have bowed down to it They have sacrificed to it and said These O Israel are your gods who brought you up out of the land of Egypt

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·hin·nêh ‘am- qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ hū
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses I have seen this people and they are indeed a stiff-necked . . . people

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הַנִּ֣יחָה לִּ֔י וְיִֽחַר־ אַפִּ֥י בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכַלֵּ֑ם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ לְג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh han·nî·ḥāh lî wə·yi·ḥar- ’ap·pî ḇā·hem wa·’ă·ḵal·lêm wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā lə·ḡō·w gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Now leave Me alone so that My anger may burn against them and consume them Then I will make you into a great nation

verses.original: וַיְחַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָמָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יֶחֱרֶ֤ה אַפְּךָ֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּכֹ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל וּבְיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥal mō·šeh ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yō·mer lā·māh Yah·weh ye·ḥĕ·reh ’ap·pə·ḵā bə·‘am·me·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·ḵō·aḥ gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh
verses.literal: But Moses sought the favor . . . of the LORD his God saying O LORD why does Your anger burn against Your people whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand

verses.original: לָמָּה֩ יֹאמְר֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר בְּרָעָ֤ה הֽוֹצִיאָם֙ לַהֲרֹ֤ג אֹתָם֙ בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּ֨לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־ הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh yō·mə·rū miṣ·ra·yim lê·mōr bə·rā·‘āh hō·w·ṣî·’ām la·hă·rōḡ ’ō·ṯām be·hā·rîm ū·lə·ḵal·lō·ṯām mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh šûb̲ mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pe·ḵā wə·hin·nā·ḥêm ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh lə·‘am·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Why should the Egyptians declare . . . . . . He brought them out with evil intent to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people

verses.original: זְכֹ֡ר לְאַבְרָהָם֩ לְיִצְחָ֨ק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתָּ לָהֶם֮ בָּךְ֒ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכָל־ הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶתֵּן֙ לְזַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וְנָחֲל֖וּ לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tā lā·hem bāḵ wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem ’ar·beh ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵem kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·mā·yim wə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî ’et·tên lə·zar·‘ă·ḵem wə·nā·ḥă·lū lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: Remember Your servants Abraham Isaac and Israel to whom You swore by Your very self when You declared . . . I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land that I have promised and it shall be their inheritance forever

verses.original: וַיִּנָּ֖חֶם יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְעַמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yin·nā·ḥem Yah·weh ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer dib·ber la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·‘am·mōw
verses.literal: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people

verses.original: וַיִּ֜פֶן וַיֵּ֤רֶד מֹשֶׁה֙ מִן־ הָהָ֔ר וּשְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָעֵדֻ֖ת בְּיָד֑וֹ לֻחֹ֗ת כְּתֻבִים֙ מִשְּׁנֵ֣י עֶבְרֵיהֶ֔ם מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה הֵ֥ם כְּתֻבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en way·yê·reḏ mō·šeh min- hā·hār ū·šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·yā·ḏōw lu·ḥōṯ kə·ṯu·ḇîm miš·šə·nê ‘eḇ·rê·hem miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh hêm kə·ṯu·ḇîm
verses.literal: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands . . . They were inscribed on both sides front and back

verses.original: וְהַ֨לֻּחֹ֔ת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּ֗ב מִכְתַּ֤ב אֱלֹהִים֙ ה֔וּא חָר֖וּת עַל־ הַלֻּחֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·lu·ḥōṯ ma·‘ă·śêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm hêm·māh wə·ham·miḵ·tāḇ miḵ·taḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm hū ḥā·rūṯ ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ
verses.literal: The tablets were the work of God . . . and the writing was the writing of God . . . engraved on the tablets

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֧ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ ק֥וֹל הָעָ֖ם בְּרֵעֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl hā·‘ām bə·rē·ʿōh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh qō·wl mil·ḥā·māh bam·ma·ḥă·nɛh
verses.literal: When Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting he said to Moses The sound of war is in the camp

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֥ין קוֹל֙ עֲנ֣וֹת גְּבוּרָ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל עֲנ֣וֹת חֲלוּשָׁ֑ה ק֣וֹל עַנּ֔וֹת אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ên qō·wl ‘ă·nō·wṯ gə·ḇū·rāh wə·’ên qō·wl ‘ă·nō·wṯ ḥă·lū·šāh qō·wl ‘an·nō·wṯ ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·mê·a‘
verses.literal: But Moses replied It is neither the cry . . . of victory nor the cry . . . of defeat I hear the sound of singing

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרַב֙ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־ הָעֵ֖גֶל וּמְחֹלֹ֑ת וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ מִיָּדוֹ אֶת־ הַלֻּחֹ֔ת וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר אֹתָ֖ם תַּ֥חַת הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer qā·raḇ ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yar ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel ū·mə·ḥō·lōṯ way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ mō·šeh way·yaš·lêḵ mī·yå̄·ḏō ’eṯ- hal·lu·ḥōṯ way·šab·bêr ’ō·ṯām ta·ḥaṯ hā·hār
verses.literal: As Moses approached . . . the camp and saw the calf and the dancing he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands shattering them at the base of the mountain

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ הָעֵ֨גֶל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּטְחַ֖ן עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר־ דָּ֑ק וַיִּ֙זֶר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū way·yiś·rōp̄ bā·’êš way·yiṭ·ḥan ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- dāq way·yi·zer ‘al- pə·nê ham·ma·yim way·yašq ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then he took the calf they had made burned it in the fire ground it to powder and scattered the powder over the face of the water Then he forced the Israelites to drink it

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן מֶֽה־ עָשָׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־ הֵבֵ֥אתָ עָלָ֖יו חֲטָאָ֥ה גְדֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- ’a·hă·rōn meh- ‘ā·śāh lə·ḵā hā·‘ām haz·zeh kî- hê·ḇê·ṯā ‘ā·lāw ḥă·ṭā·’āh ḡə·ḏō·lāh
verses.literal: What did this people do to you Moses . . . asked Aaron that you have led them into so great a sin

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַל־ יִ֥חַר אַ֖ף אֲדֹנִ֑י אַתָּה֙ יָדַ֣עְתָּ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י בְרָ֖ע הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’a·hă·rōn ’al- yi·ḥar ’ap̄ ’ă·ḏō·nî ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām kî ḇə·rā‘ hū
verses.literal: Do not be enraged . . . my lord Aaron replied You yourself know that the people . . . are intent on evil . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔י עֲשֵׂה־ לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵלְכ֖וּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ כִּי־ זֶ֣ה׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־ הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lî ‘ă·śêh- lā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer yê·lə·ḵū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū kî- zeh mō·šeh hā·’îš ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lō yā·ḏa‘·nū meh- hā·yāh lōw
verses.literal: They told me Make us gods who will go before us As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt we do not know what has happened to him

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לְמִ֣י זָהָ֔ב הִתְפָּרָ֖קוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ־ לִ֑י וָאַשְׁלִכֵ֣הוּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וַיֵּצֵ֖א הָעֵ֥גֶל הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar lā·hem lə·mî zā·hāḇ hiṯ·pā·rā·qū way·yit·tə·nū- lî wā·’aš·li·ḵê·hū ḇā·’êš way·yê·ṣê hā·‘ê·ḡel haz·zeh
verses.literal: So I said to them Whoever has gold let him take it off and they gave it to me And when I threw it into the fire out came this calf

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י פָרֻ֖עַ ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ פְרָעֹ֣ה אַהֲרֹ֔ן לְשִׁמְצָ֖ה בְּקָמֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar mō·šeh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām kî p̄ā·ru·a‘ hū kî- p̄ə·rā·‘ōh ’a·hă·rōn lə·šim·ṣāh bə·qā·mê·hem
verses.literal: Moses saw that the people were out of control . . . . . . for Aaron had let them run wild and become a laughingstock to their enemies

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לַיהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וַיֵּאָסְפ֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ mō·šeh bə·ša·‘ar ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yō·mer mî Yah·weh ’ê·lāy way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū ’ê·lāw kāl- bə·nê lê·wî
verses.literal: So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said Whoever is for the LORD come to me And all the Levites . . . gathered around him

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׂ֥ימוּ אִישׁ־ חַרְבּ֖וֹ עַל־ יְרֵכ֑וֹ עִבְר֨וּ וָשׁ֜וּבוּ מִשַּׁ֤עַר לָשַׁ֙עַר֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהִרְג֧וּ אִֽישׁ־ אֶת־ אָחִ֛יו וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ קְרֹבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl śî·mū ’îš- ḥar·bōw ‘al- yə·rê·ḵōw ‘iḇ·rū wā·šū·ḇū miš·ša·‘ar lā·ša·‘ar bam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·hir·ḡū ’îš- ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw wə·’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wə·’îš ’eṯ- qə·rō·ḇōw
verses.literal: He told them This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Each of you men is to fasten his sword to his side go back and forth . . . through the camp from gate to gate - and slay his brother . . . his friend . . . and his neighbor

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֖י כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּפֹּ֤ל מִן־ הָעָם֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כִּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֖י אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- lê·wî kiḏ·ḇar mō·šeh way·yip·pōl min- hā·‘ām bay·yō·wm ha·hū kiš·lō·šeṯ ’al·p̄ê ’îš
verses.literal: The Levites . . . did as Moses commanded and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה מִלְא֨וּ יֶדְכֶ֤ם הַיּוֹם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בִּבְנ֖וֹ וּבְאָחִ֑יו וְלָתֵ֧ת עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם בְּרָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh mil·’ū yeḏ·ḵem hay·yō·wm Yah·weh kî ’îš biḇ·nōw ū·ḇə·’ā·ḥîw wə·lā·ṯêṯ ‘ă·lê·ḵem hay·yō·wm bə·rā·ḵāh
verses.literal: Afterward, Moses said Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD since each man went against his son and his brother so the LORD has bestowed a blessing on you this day

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם אַתֶּ֥ם חֲטָאתֶ֖ם חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה וְעַתָּה֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה אוּלַ֥י אֲכַפְּרָ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד חַטַּאתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- hā·‘ām ’at·tem ḥă·ṭā·ṯem ḥă·ṭā·’āh ḡə·ḏō·lāh wə·‘at·tāh ’e·‘ĕ·leh ’el- Yah·weh ’ū·lay ’ă·ḵap·pə·rāh bə·‘aḏ ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: The next day Moses said to the people You have committed a great sin Now I will go up to the LORD perhaps I can make atonement for your sin

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אָ֣נָּ֗א חָטָ֞א הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar ’ān·nā ḥā·ṭā hā·‘ām haz·zeh ḥă·ṭā·’āh ḡə·ḏō·lāh way·ya·‘ă·śū lā·hem ’ĕ·lō·hê zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: So Moses returned to the LORD and said Oh what a great sin these people have committed They have made gods of gold for themselves

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אִם־ תִּשָּׂ֣א חַטָּאתָ֑ם וְאִם־ אַ֕יִן מְחֵ֣נִי נָ֔א מִֽסִּפְרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתָֽבְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- tiś·śā ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām wə·’im- ’a·yin mə·ḥê·nî nā mis·sip̄·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer kā·ṯā·ḇə·tā
verses.literal: Yet now if You would only forgive their sin But if not please blot me out of the book that You have written

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִ֚י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטָא־ לִ֔י אֶמְחֶ֖נּוּ מִסִּפְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh mî ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā- lî ’em·ḥen·nū mis·sip̄·rî
verses.literal: The LORD replied to Moses Whoever has sinned against Me I will blot out of My book

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה לֵ֣ךְ׀ נְחֵ֣ה אֶת־ הָעָ֗ם אֶ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ לָ֔ךְ הִנֵּ֥ה מַלְאָכִ֖י יֵלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וּבְי֣וֹם פָּקְדִ֔י וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם חַטָּאתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lêḵ nə·ḥêh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’el ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî lāḵ hin·nêh mal·’ā·ḵî yê·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·yō·wm pā·qə·ḏî ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām
verses.literal: Now go lead the people to the place I described Behold My angel shall go before you But on the day I settle accounts I will punish them . . . for their sin

verses.original: וַיִּגֹּ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הָעֵ֔גֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אַהֲרֹֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gōp̄ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ‘al ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: And the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they had done with the calf that Aaron had made
